resources.string: Create an identity QR for trusted in-person verification.
Enter your phone number and create your cryptographic identity.
Only part of your identity is available. Replacement keys will not be generated automatically.
Your private keys are protected locally
This pattern is drawn from your keys.
Daily limit of phone verifications reached. Contacts cannot find you by your number until it is verified.
Your public encryption and signing keys are always included. Your private keys never leave this device.
Let the other person scan this QR directly from your device to verify your identity.
Shared or copied identity text does not verify you by itself. In-person QR scanning or safety-number comparison is still required.
This number becomes your stable Sparrow routing address.

You have not backed up this identity. If you reinstall Sparrow or change devices, you may lose your original keys and your contacts may no longer recognize you. Export an encrypted backup. It saves your identity keys, not chats or message history.
Backup exported. Keep the file and password safe. You can export again at any time; chats and contacts are not included.

Your original identity keys have been restored. Chats, contacts, and authorizations are not in this backup. To reconnect, use Chats → New chat to invite your contact again, or ask them to open your old conversation and choose Reconnect contact. They do not need to replace your identity when you restored the original keys. Keep your backup file and password safe.
Select your backup file and enter its password. Enter your phone number on the identity setup screen before restoring. This restores your original keys only, not your previous chats or contacts.

This invitation proposes new keys. It may be from someone else: a matching phone number does not prove identity. Accepting trusts the keys shown below and continues the signed invitation with the new identity. Your existing chat stays on this device.
When a contact needs to verify your new identity, share this value through a separate trusted channel.
Your identity could not be created. Please try again.
The phone number could not be read from this device. Enter it manually.
We will send a code by SMS to %1$s.
Enter the code we sent by SMS to %1$s.
The code could not be sent. Check the number and try again.
Identity setup could not be loaded. Please restart Sparrow.
The identity could not be restored. Check the backup and password, then try again.
Your identity can no longer be used on this device

The keys of your identity on this phone are lost, for example after the app data was moved to another phone or the screen lock of the phone changed. Your chats and contacts are still here. Restore the keys from your identity backup to keep everything. Without a backup, only a reset is possible, which deletes all chats and contacts.
Enter the password of your identity backup. Only a backup of this identity is accepted.
This deletes all chats and contacts on this device and starts with a new identity. Your contacts have to accept you again. This cannot be undone.
This backup belongs to a different identity. Choose the backup of the identity used on this device.
The keys could not be restored. Check the backup and password, then try again.
The identity could not be reset. Try again.
Enter a valid phone number before restoring your identity.
The identity backup could not be read. Select a valid backup file.
Your identity could not be loaded. Please try again.
Profile picture could not be saved. Please try again.
Profile picture could not be removed. Please try again.
The identity backup could not be completed. Please try again.
